name: LM-01
sample_resource_namespace: lm01; rename to the real mod namespace during integration
notes: Original fictional exterior game artwork. No functional internals.
Plain Java cuboids and allowed single-axis Y rotations.
The matching block JSON can be baked and rendered as a normal block.
This package does not register a block or implement contact, damage, explosion, inventory or drone placement.
A model file does not decide whether gameplay uses an Entity or BlockEntity; register an ordinary block and use static model rendering.
Texture and UVs are fully opaque; no glass/transparency sorting dependency.
